property_summary: Once a Collect() external call is in flight, any reentrant SetMinSum must revert so MinSum is immutable at its previously set value for all inputs; the mutant's missing lock check lets the reentrant SetMinSum succeed and change MinSum.
change_summary: Delete `require(!locked_);` from the nonReentrant_ modifier so SetMinSum succeeds even when the lock is held (e.g. during a reentrant call from Collect), changing the resulting MinSum.
